event_alignment_reconciliation.finding: Reconciliation of SST row at t=0 ms in prose report against aligned_to_sst_spikes.summary_at_burst.SST in sealed JSON
event_alignment_reconciliation.index_semantics: In JaxFNE discrete-time engine execution at dt=0.1 ms, when a neuron crosses threshold (v >= 30.0 mV), the state recorded at the spike timestamp (spk=1) has already applied the reset boundary v <- -65.0 mV and adaptation increment u <- u + d. In scripts/analyze_ei_native_state.py, valid_sst indices correspond to spk=1 (offset 0), so array values at offset 0 are post-reset. At offset -1 (-0.1 ms), the cell is at its pre-reset depolarization peak.

t_minus_0p1ms.note: Pre-reset peak depolarization step; matches report table values (v=30.00 nominal, I_net=3.52).

t_0ms.note: Spike event timestamp in array (spk=1); matches aligned_to_sst_spikes.summary_at_burst in sealed JSON.

event_alignment_reconciliation.verdict_impact: None. At both offsets, PV receives sub-rheobase net current (2.95 < 4.0) and VIP is deeply hyperpolarized (-85.87 mV with positive adaptation u=+8.58), independently confirming DYNAMIC_RECRUITMENT_DEFICIT for PV and INTRINSIC_STATE_VETO for VIP.

sst_rate_hz.resolution: Prose citation of 50.20 Hz was a transcription of historical EI interaction SST rate (50.1991 Hz). Canonical sealed value is 50.23 Hz.

e_conditional_spike_probability_bin_3_to.resolution: Prose notation 6.2e-4 was a reporting typo; canonical sealed value is exactly 0.000649.
